questions.question: Where will growth and renewal come from?
How must the organisation work differently?
How do leaders and teams make that happen?

modules.title: Building a Visionary Company: Stimulate progress, preserve the core
modules.description: Build a clear aspiration, a vivid description of the future, an embraced purpose and lived values for effective execution.

modules.title: Playing to Win: defining where to play, how to win
modules.description: Build your value-creation plan applying the 'Playing to win' methodology

modules.title: Future-Back Strategy
modules.description: Instead of extrapolating your current business model, imagine future business models based on customer jobs-to-be-done, and work back from there to the required innovation portfolio and action plan going forward.

modules.title: Understanding Disruption
modules.description: Recognise disruptive threats and opportunities early applying Clayton Christensen's theory of disruption .

modules.title: Strategy and Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
modules.description: Make faster, better decisions and create a portfolio providing optionallity when information is incomplete.

modules.title: Strategy Execution: OKRs & OGSM
modules.description: Translate strategic choices into priorities, objectives, measures, ownership and adaptation using approaches such as OKRs and OGSM.

modules.title: Rockefeller Habits: High-Performance Management Cadence
modules.description: Build management rhythms, priorities and accountability for consistent execution.

modules.title: Adaptive Performance Management / Beyond Budgeting
modules.description: Improve the annual planning cycle by redesign of targeting, forecasting, resource allocation, evaluating and rewarding processes.

modules.title: Systems Thinking
modules.description: Learn to see hidden feedback loops, dependencies and unintended consequences of well-intended management actions.

modules.title: Entrepreneurship & Innovation Principles
modules.description: Build a practical foundation in entrepreneurship and innovation: customer jobs, circumstances, the Business Model Canvas, testing and de-risking.

modules.title: Business Model Innovation
modules.description: Learn to speak a common language and method to effectively and efficiently explore opportunities to serve customer needs in new ways.

modules.title: Experimentation: From Idea to Evidence
modules.description: Learn to de-risk: Turn assumptions with high impact but low confidence into tests and evidence before large commitments.

modules.title: Innovation Portfolio Management
modules.description: Build and manage an innovation portfolio that's sufficient, balanced, and optimized to reliably deliver on your growth strategy.

modules.title: Leading Entrepreneurial Organisations & Disruptive Innovation
modules.description: Create the conditions, structures and leadership practices that allow experimentation and disruptive new growth to develop alongside the demands of the core business.

modules.title: AI Literacy & Practical Application
modules.description: Understand what AI can and cannot do, use it responsibly, assess outputs and identify practical applications that improve real work.

modules.title: Managing with AI
modules.description: Use, supervise and make sound judgements with AI in everyday work.

modules.title: Managing AI Agents
modules.description: Delegate to, supervise and evaluate artificial agents.

modules.title: Building the Hybrid Human-Agent Organisation
modules.description: Reconsider tasks, processes and roles between people and AI. Address structure, accountability and operating-model implications.

modules.title: Leading AI Transformation & Adoption
modules.description: Understand the human and organisational dynamics that determine whether AI is adopted.

modules.title: AI Governance & Oversight
modules.description: Understand the opportunities, responsibilities, risks and oversight choices leaders need to govern AI responsibly.

modules.title: Jobs to Be Done as the foundation for growth
modules.description: Understand the progress customers are trying to make and turn that insight into better customer propositions, communication and innovation opportunities.

modules.title: Pricing
modules.description: Strengthen pricing logic using customer value, economics and market behaviour.

modules.title: Sales & Change: Understanding the Four Forces of Adoption
modules.description: Use the four forces that shape leaving the old and embracing the new to get customers or employees buy into your proposition.

modules.title: Building a customer-centric and sales-oriented organisation
modules.description: Translate customer orientation into routines, information and decisions. Make commercial orientation an organisational capability.

modules.title: Adaptability Audit
modules.description: Identify hidden barriers between signal and action and find the leverage point that will increase adaptability.

modules.title: Bureaucracy Busting
modules.description: Design your organisaation for speed and safety, coherence and autonomy, purpose and profit.

modules.title: Culture as a Management System
modules.description: Understand culture and learn to manage it as the enabler of company performance.

modules.title: Current and Desired Culture Change
modules.description: Identify what supports the strategy and what needs to change using a fact-based culture map and pragmatic change interventions.

modules.title: Purpose and Values for Performance
modules.description: Understand what a purpose-driven organisation means and how to build it with values that direct behaviour needed for successful execution.

modules.title: Tension to Traction: A different thinking for breakthrough performance
modules.description: Learn to navigate dilemmas by connecting two positive but competing demands rather than settling for compromise. Includes lessons from recent CEO interviews, as captured in the forthcoming book Tension to Traction.

modules.title: Leading Change
modules.description: Create meaning and shape the social dynamics that determine adoption.

modules.title: Culture for M&A Value Creation
modules.description: Surface differences as a source of deal value by building on the best of both.

modules.title: Learning from Netflix Culture
modules.description: Learn about the unique culture of Netflix and lessons for your own organisation.

modules.title: Motivation: What Really Drives People
modules.description: Understand the fundamental sources of intrinsic motivation and the impact of leadership and management to unleash performance.

modules.title: Delegation, Autonomy, Trust & Accountability
modules.description: Delegate meaningful responsibility and build trust while remaining clear on outcomes, boundaries, standards and accountability.

modules.title: Performance Conversations
modules.description: Hold clear conversations about expectations, performance, development and accountability.

modules.title: Building High-Performing Teams
modules.description: Strengthen trust, belonging, productive debate, cross-functional collaboration, commitment and accountability.

modules.title: Psychological Safety
modules.description: Increase candour, speaking up and learning while maintaining high standards.

modules.title: Sustainable Performance & Burnout Prevention
modules.description: Build healthier ways of working that protect energy, performance and accountability.

modules.title: Constructive Conflict and Dialogue
modules.description: Use disagreement productively without artificial harmony or destructive conflict. Use pull vs. push techniques

modules.title: Effective Meetings: Decisions, Not Theatre
modules.description: Design meetings around decisions, ownership and follow-through.

modules.title: Communicating Ideas That Land
modules.description: Structure messages so others can understand, challenge and act.

modules.title: Influencing & Stakeholder Management
modules.description: Build support without relying solely on formal authority. Use pull vs. push techniques.

modules.title: Giving & Receiving Feedback
modules.description: Make feedback frequent, useful and safe enough to improve performance.

modules.title: Negotiation & Tough Conversations
modules.description: Navigate competing interests and trade-offs while protecting relationships.

modules.title: The Power of Humour
modules.description: Use humour appropriately to improve relationships, resilience and candour.
